isolation_plan.decision_rule: Attribute the smoke's Pi_D reordering (top-2 = car/airplane instead of reference car/truck) from the two bounded isolation arms (each ablates exactly ONE AIS sub-mechanism, everything else identical to the smoke): (1) if Isolation A (--no-ais-halting) restores car/truck in top-2, the entropy-gated halting / continuation-weighted belief accumulation is the primary driver; (2) if Isolation B (--no-ais-precision-recon) restores car/truck in top-2, the precision-modulated reconstruction weight is the primary driver; (3) if both restore, both contribute - the next isolation runs a combined-off arm; (4) if neither restores, the driver is the remaining shared AIS wiring (gaze-policy relocation / step_net / continuation x belief interplay) - the next isolation disables step_net, or a per-class error/gaze-coverage analysis runs on the smoke artifacts. In every branch Step B stays GATED until the ordering question is understood; the isolation verdict is recorded regardless of outcome (a null/ambiguous isolation is a valid, reportable result).

optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.nature: OPTIMIZER CONFIGURATION correction - NOT a loss-budget or gate-criteria change; the original pre-registration (w_hpc=0.10, all health-gate criteria) stands unchanged.
optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.commits: 8bb564f (two-group SGD + per-group clip) + ed05c85 (resume guard + tests)
optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.gate_criteria_unchanged: all Stage 2 health-gate checks exactly as pre-registered (1 gradient flow, 2 hpc_error_trend >=10%, 3 disable backward-compat, 4 pi_d car/truck ordering, 5 optimizer-group resume guard)
optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.trigger: Smoke #3 (genuine cold start @ commit 7c8b39b) froze hpc_error_mean at the predict-zero baseline 0.6904 -> 0.6911 (ratio 1.00) across 15 epochs; epoch-15 output conv sat exactly at its +/-0.01 init draw (abs-mean 0.00516).
optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.root_cause_measured: optimizer starvation: w_hpc=0.1 x shared backbone lr 0.003 x global clip_grad_norm_(all 76M params, 1.0) whose norm the backbone TRADES gradient dominates (~1000x attenuation; raw last-conv grad ~0.004 vs 0.54 isolated; per-step |dW| ~1.4e-5 on |W|~0.005).
optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.fix: Two SGD param groups: backbone lr=0.003, hpc_stack lr=0.003*6.67=0.02 (phase 1) with per-group grad clip (clip_grad_per_group); resume guard refuses group-count / LR-ratio mismatch (restore_optimizer_from_checkpoint).

pre_flight_2026_08_13.script: scratch/measure_hpc_dw.py (real base ckpt rhan_next_ais_v1_halting_only_best.pth, STL10-normalized inputs, backbone frozen so only the HPC head per-step |dW| is measured - faithful for this quantity)
pre_flight_2026_08_13.real_recipe_result: last-conv |dW|/step mean 2.74e-3 (rel 2.85%/step); HPC err 0.1974 -> 0.1799 (8.9% drop over 24 optimizer steps); 201.8x the pre-fix 1.36e-5 per-step movement
pre_flight_2026_08_13.isolated_reference_result: last-conv |dW|/step 2.27e-3 (rel 2.15%/step) at lr=0.05 / w_hpc=1.0 / no clip (ran post-A on the same weights; the committed test_hpc_head_learns_under_real_recipe 27%-in-60-steps remains the canonical isolated reference)
pre_flight_2026_08_13.verdict: PROCEED - all 4 criteria PASS (C1 >=5x starved, C2 rel >=1%/step, C3 error declines, C4 within ~10x of isolated). Head movement is in the learnable regime; re-run the full 15-epoch smoke with the SAME health gate.
pre_flight_2026_08_13.caveats: random normalized inputs -> predict-zero error baseline 0.197 lower than the smoke's real-image ~0.69; real-image gradients are larger, so this is a conservative lower bound on per-step movement

optimizer_configuration_fix_2026_08_13.next_action: Re-run the full 15-epoch Stage 2 smoke (same gate). Expect hpc_error_mean flat through epochs 1-5 warmup (HPC frozen - expected) then declining from epoch 6.
